externalReferences.purpose: Canonical Compose environment, Secret-file and immutable image inputs.
Cluster-specific image import, node preparation, storage, ingress and overlay commands.
Existing Kubernetes and Istio cluster lifecycle; UI4A does not duplicate its private material.

commands.command: unset http_proxy https_proxy HTTP_PROXY HTTPS_PROXY ALL_PROXY all_proxy; kubectl version; kubectl get nodes -o wide; kubectl get namespace ui4a-system --show-labels
commands.expectedOutput: Kubernetes v1.31.14, three Ready nodes, and ui4a-system with istio-injection=enabled when already installed.
commands.failureCriterion: kubectl cannot reach the cluster, any node is NotReady, or surveyed versions/node names differ.
commands.recoveryAction: Stop before rendering; follow ../mothership-setup/K8S-ISTIO-DEPLOY.md to restore the existing cluster.

commands.command: kubectl get storageclass,pv; kubectl -n ui4a-system get pvc -o wide
commands.expectedOutput: Exactly postgres/runtime/backup/pki claims are Bound to reviewed Retain volumes or a reviewed replaceable StorageClass.
commands.failureCriterion: A claim is Pending, a local path/node differs from the overlay, or reclaimPolicy is not Retain.
commands.recoveryAction: Do not delete claims; correct the overlay or provisioner decision and repeat the read-only inventory.

chapters.title: 内网镜像构建、传输、预拉和 digest 验证

commands.command: ../mothership-setup/deploy/ui4a/verify-overlay.sh; ssh k8s-w-2 'sudo crictl --runtime-endpoint unix:///run/containerd/containerd.sock images'
commands.expectedOutput: Overlay PASS and every release image available by immutable @sha256 reference with the release OCI revision.
commands.failureCriterion: Any placeholder, mutable tag, digest mismatch, missing layer, or OCI revision mismatch.
commands.recoveryAction: Stop; repeat the exact export/checksum/import procedure in the mothership overlay runbook without pruning containerd content.

commands.command: kubectl -n ui4a-system get gateway,virtualservice,requestauthentication,authorizationpolicy; kubectl get namespace ui4a-system --show-labels
commands.expectedOutput: The namespace is injected and the UI4A Gateway, two host routes, JWT rule and authorization policies exist.
commands.failureCriterion: Injection is absent, hosts/issuer/audience drift, or an internal callback route is exposed externally.
commands.recoveryAction: Do not bypass Istio; fix values and rerender deploy/helm/ui4a before apply.

commands.command: ssh k8s-cp-1 "helm upgrade --install ui4a '<reviewed-chart>' -n ui4a-system -f '<reviewed-values>' --wait --wait-for-jobs --timeout 15m"
commands.expectedOutput: A new release is deployed only after namespace, Secret metadata, storage and render gates pass.
commands.failureCriterion: Helm reports a failed revision, an immutable Job patch, or any workload/PVC is not ready.
commands.recoveryAction: Stop and inspect the failed revision; do not use --force or delete retained state.

commands.command: kubectl -n istio-system get secret ui4a-internal-tls -o custom-columns=NAME:.metadata.name,TYPE:.type; kubectl -n ui4a-system get pvc pki-data
commands.expectedOutput: Ingress TLS Secret metadata exists and retained pki-data is Bound; both internal DNS SANs are verified by the mothership runbook.
commands.failureCriterion: TLS metadata is missing, SAN/issuer is wrong, or pki-data is not retained.
commands.recoveryAction: Stop; restore certificate/PKI artifacts from the verified backup. Never regenerate over an existing root CA or private key.

commands.command: kubectl -n ui4a-system rollout status statefulset/postgres --timeout=180s; kubectl -n ui4a-system get job postgres-bootstrap
commands.expectedOutput: PostgreSQL 1/1 Ready and postgres-bootstrap Complete with TLS verify-full configuration.
commands.failureCriterion: StatefulSet is not Ready, bootstrap is not Complete, or postgres-data UID/path changes.
commands.recoveryAction: Inspect postgres and bootstrap logs; do not recreate postgres-data or reset roles.

commands.command: kubectl -n ui4a-system rollout status deployment/temporal --timeout=180s; kubectl -n ui4a-system get job temporal-schema temporal-namespace
commands.expectedOutput: Temporal and UI are Ready, schema and namespace Jobs have Complete conditions, and namespace ui4a exists.
commands.failureCriterion: Schema/namespace Job is active or terminal-failed, gRPC probe fails, or persistence authentication fails.
commands.recoveryAction: Keep PostgreSQL intact; inspect Job/server previous logs and rerun only an explicitly reviewed idempotent Job.

chapters.title: Keycloak 固定 realm 首次导入与兼容性检查

commands.command: pnpm --filter @ui4a/worker exec tsx ../../scripts/t22/keycloak/t22-keycloak-realm-bootstrap.ts --check; test -f deploy/keycloak/realm-import.json
commands.expectedOutput: A missing realm reports absent; an existing compatible realm reports skip without mutation.
commands.failureCriterion: KEYCLOAK_REALM_INCOMPATIBLE, an unexpected client set, or any request for drift repair.
commands.recoveryAction: Back up identity state and stop. Replace/rebuild explicitly; never reconcile an existing realm online.

commands.command: kubectl -n ui4a-system wait --for=condition=complete job/migration --timeout=300s; kubectl -n ui4a-system logs job/migration -c migration
commands.expectedOutput: Migration Job is Complete and reports the expected compatible schema revision.
commands.failureCriterion: Job is active/failed, schema revision is unexpected, or a destructive migration is proposed.
commands.recoveryAction: Stop application rollout; preserve the named backup and use the reviewed compatibility window.

commands.command: kubectl -n ui4a-system rollout status deployment/web --timeout=180s; kubectl -n ui4a-system rollout status deployment/worker --timeout=180s
commands.expectedOutput: Single Web and Worker replicas are Ready with immutable release digests.
commands.failureCriterion: Either workload is degraded/not Ready or image/source revision differs from the release.
commands.recoveryAction: Inspect dependency readiness and rollback images; do not scale beyond the supported single replica.

commands.command: kubectl -n ui4a-system auth can-i create jobs --as=system:serviceaccount:ui4a-system:ui4a-worker; kubectl -n ui4a-system get jobs -l app.kubernetes.io/name=ui4a-agent-runner
commands.expectedOutput: Worker RBAC permits bounded one-shot Jobs; idle state has no static Runner daemon and each Run has one immutable Job.
commands.failureCriterion: RBAC is broader/missing, an idle daemon exists, or a Run can override image/profile/workspace.
commands.recoveryAction: Disable K8s dispatch and correct server-owned settings/RBAC; never fall back to a wider backend.

commands.command: UI4A_RUNNER_ID='<server-owned-id>' UI4A_RUNNER_TOKEN="$(< '<absolute-0600-token-file>')" node apps/agent-runner/dist/main.js daemon
commands.expectedOutput: The configured Runner becomes ready and accepts only its exact profile, workspace, image and credential refs.
commands.failureCriterion: runner_delivery_not_configured, token/profile mismatch, path escape, or readiness without an authorized processor.
commands.recoveryAction: Stop the daemon, preserve workspace evidence, fix canonical settings/private token file, and restart without widening permissions.

commands.command: getent hosts ui4a.mothership.internal auth.ui4a.mothership.internal; curl --cacert '<reviewed-panel-ca-copy>' https://ui4a.mothership.internal:32067/.well-known/ui4a.json
commands.expectedOutput: Both names resolve to the reviewed ingress address and TLS validation succeeds without -k.
commands.failureCriterion: Resolution differs, curl needs -k, or certificate SAN/chain validation fails.
commands.recoveryAction: Correct DNS/hosts or install the reviewed public CA certificate; never distribute a private key.

commands.command: pnpm cli:build; UI4A_TOKEN='<memory-only-bearer>' node apps/cli/dist/main.js doctor; pnpm vitest run apps/web/src/auth/authentication-negative.test.ts apps/cli/src/production-authentication.test.ts
commands.expectedOutput: PKCE human login, CLI Bearer reads and bounded sub+azp delegation pass; malformed/expired/forged credentials fail closed.
commands.failureCriterion: Any Agent approval succeeds, scope expands, identity comes from request fields, or credential material appears in output.
commands.recoveryAction: Revoke the test credential, stop acceptance, inspect issuer/audience/JWKS/application identity checks, and do not weaken policy.

commands.command: pnpm compose:t22 backup; pnpm compose:t22 restore-plan
commands.expectedOutput: Compose returns explicit quiesced-pg-dump and isolated non-destructive restore plans.
commands.failureCriterion: Preflight fails, backup lacks a verified quiescence receipt, or restore targets current volumes.
commands.recoveryAction: Keep the current stack and volumes; correct the canonical request before running the backup/restore executors.

commands.command: CI=true pnpm e2e invariants
commands.expectedOutput: Business flow, delegated proposal, human-only approval, both Runtime backends, restart and audit evidence pass.
commands.failureCriterion: A Pod Running/HTTP 200 substitutes for the story, an Agent approves, or replay/audit evidence differs.
commands.recoveryAction: Keep the experimental release unaccepted; diagnose the first failed user-story boundary and rerun from a clean fixture.

commands.command: pnpm --filter @ui4a/worker exec tsx ../../scripts/t22/recovery/t22-k8s-recovery-observe-command.ts capture; pnpm --filter @ui4a/worker exec tsx ../../scripts/t22/recovery/t22-k8s-recovery-command.ts plan; test -f scripts/t22/recovery/t22-k8s-recovery-live.ts
commands.expectedOutput: A named completed manifest covers four databases, runtime, realm/config, PKI/private artifacts; isolated restore reports RPO/RTO and matching authority/identity/Run evidence.
commands.failureCriterion: Checksums/inventory/quiescence are incomplete, target aliases current state, or restored fingerprints differ.
commands.recoveryAction: Resume current writers, retain the incomplete archive for diagnosis, and never restore into the current PVC/database.

commands.command: ssh k8s-cp-1 "helm upgrade ui4a '<reviewed-chart>' -n ui4a-system -f '<reviewed-values>' --wait --wait-for-jobs --timeout 15m"; ssh k8s-cp-1 'helm rollback ui4a 19 -n ui4a-system --wait --wait-for-jobs --timeout 15m'
commands.expectedOutput: New revision passes smoke, rollback restores old image refs, roll-forward restores the new revision, and HWM/authority hash remain equal.
commands.failureCriterion: Rendered retained Jobs differ, migration is incompatible, smoke fails, or HWM/hash changes unexpectedly.
commands.recoveryAction: Rollback to revision 19 without --force; if data recovery is required, use the verified backup only in an isolated target first.

chapters.title: 日志、健康检查和常见故障

commands.command: kubectl -n ui4a-system get pods,jobs,pvc -o wide; kubectl -n ui4a-system get events --sort-by=.lastTimestamp; kubectl -n ui4a-system logs deployment/web -c web --tail=200
commands.expectedOutput: Liveness, readiness and dependency failures are distinguishable and logs contain correlation IDs without credentials.
commands.failureCriterion: degraded is reported Ready, previous container errors are hidden, or logs expose Token/API key/password/prompt material.
commands.recoveryAction: Capture only redacted metadata and previous logs, repair the named dependency, then rerun readiness and the bounded smoke.

commands.command: pnpm compose:t22 down; pnpm compose:t22 clean --confirm-destroy-volumes ui4a; ssh k8s-cp-1 'helm uninstall ui4a -n ui4a-system'
commands.expectedOutput: Ordinary Compose stop retains volumes; destructive Compose clean requires the exact project confirmation; Helm uninstall leaves Retain PV data for explicit disposition.
commands.failureCriterion: Ordinary stop contains --volumes, any prune/force command appears, or uninstall implicitly deletes retained data.
commands.recoveryAction: Cancel before confirmation. Inventory named volumes/PVC/PV and backup checksums; data deletion is a separate reviewed operation outside this runbook.
